units.characteristics: wisdom as the LORD's creative attribute (arena, thin IB)
units.gist: wisdom/understanding/knowledge as the fabric of creation - the cosmic scope of the wisdom the disciple prizes; oblique IB (arena)

units.characteristics: the inner postures the LORD draws near or turns from (devious/scorner vs upright/humble)
units.gist: the devious=abomination but the upright are in his confidence (sod); scorners scorned, the humble given favour - interior posture positions the self toward/away from God's intimacy

units.characteristics: urgent self-humbling to escape a self-made bind
units.gist: caught in suretyship: 'save yourself, hasten, plead urgently... give your eyes no sleep' - the interior mobilised to self-rescue, pride laid down to plead

units.characteristics: wisdom's delight and rejoicing (joy as wisdom's native climate)
units.gist: wisdom 'daily his delight, rejoicing before him... delighting in the children of man' (30-31); joy directed Godward and manward (24,28 = cosmic arena, thin IB)

units.characteristics: the child's wisdom/folly felt in the parent's heart
units.gist: wise son gladdens the father, foolish son sorrows the mother - inner states shared across the generational bond (recurs 17:21,25, 23:24-25)
false balance an abomination, just weight his delight - integrity at the concealed weighing is what God delights in (w/ Job 31:6)
